faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (acast liefert ueber /livestitches/ - die Datei wird beim Abruf zusammengesetzt, Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst acast.com) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher; Clip-Erzeugung lieferte keinen verwendbaren Ausschnitt

einzeiler: The podcast takes a brief summer break and returns after Labor Day.
kurzfassung: The podcast is taking a short summer break for the next few weeks and will return right after Labor Day with new episodes. Listeners are encouraged to catch up on previous episodes featuring conversations about the Odyssey, the Supreme Court, and midterm politics. The team also invites audience feedback and story suggestions via email or voice note during the hiatus.
stichpunkte: The podcast is taking a short summer break for the next few weeks.
New episodes will resume right after Labor Day.
The show has been running for four months.
Listeners can catch up on past episodes, including talks with Mary Beard and Ellie Mistal.
The team encourages listeners to send story ideas and feedback via email or voice note.
Audience favorites will be shared on Instagram during the break.
A new studio will be revealed when the show returns in September.
beschreibung:
Stateside with Kai and Carter is taking a short end of summer break.

We'll be back with new episodes after Labor Day.

Make sure to catch previous episodes on YouTube, Apple, or Spotify. See you soon!
